nodes.name: Proposal Accept Webhook
nodes.notes: Module 2.4 ke proposal email me ye link hota hai: {PROPOSAL_ACCEPT_BASE_URL}/webhook/proposal-accept?lead_id={id}. Client click karega to ye flow shuru hoga.

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM clients_master WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$json.query.lead_id}} LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Documenso - Create Document from Template
nodes.notes: DOCUMENSO_CONTRACT_TEMPLATE_ID ek pehle se Documenso me banaya hua contract template hai (standard Nivy service agreement, merge-fields ke saath). externalId se hum lead ko document se map karte hain.

parameters.query:
UPDATE clients_master
SET status = 'Contract Sent',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$('Fetch Lead + Proposal').item.json.odoo_lead_id}};

parameters.responseBody: =Thanks {{$('Fetch Lead + Proposal').item.json.name}}! Your contract has been sent to {{$('Fetch Lead + Proposal').item.json.email}} for e-signature. Please check your inbox.

nodes.name: Documenso Signed Webhook
nodes.notes: Documenso document 'COMPLETED' event par ye webhook call hota hai (Node 3 me hi webhookUrl set kiya tha).

nodes.name: Odoo - Set CRM Stage to Won
nodes.notes: ODOO_WON_STAGE_ID = 'Won' stage ki Odoo internal ID (Configuration -> Stages me dekho).

nodes.name: Report to Hub
nodes.notes: S4.4 — replaces the direct 'Execute Workflow - 2.6 Invoice + Payment' mesh link. Fires in parallel off 'Postgres - Mark Won' (same branch as 'Odoo - Set CRM Stage to Won') so the Odoo notify / Respond 200 OK chain isn't blocked waiting on the Hub round trip — same non-blocking pattern used for 'Report to Hub' in 1.4 and 1.5. NOTE: Hub-Dispatcher does not have a contract.signed branch wired yet (S4 scope, not S0-S3) — until that Switch branch + 2.6's real workflow ID are added, events land in funnel_events and fall through to flagged_events, same safety net every other not-yet-wired event type gets.

nodes.name: Security - Parse HMAC Accept Token
nodes.notes: 3.0.1.3. Reads accept_token from the query string (matches this workflow's existing $json.query.lead_id convention).

nodes.name: Security - Verify HMAC Signature and Expiry
nodes.notes: 3.0.1.4. Uses timingSafeEqual. A valid signature with an expired timestamp is still rejected.

nodes.name: Security - Token Verified?
nodes.notes: 3.0.1.5. FIXED from the original patch file's typeVersion mismatch -- uses this build's standard filter/conditions schema (matches every other IF node in Modules 1.x/2.x), not the older boolean-array schema.

nodes.name: Odoo Discuss - Accept Token Rejected Alert
nodes.notes: Added per master tracker's own spec for 3.0.1.5 ('reject + alert branch') -- same alert-on-security-failure pattern the tracker requires for 3.0.2/3.0.3.
